name: Indian Infotech and Software Limited
about: Indian Infotech and Software Limited, a non-banking finance company, engages in the business of financing in India. It involves finance and shares trading activities; and the provision of business loans to individuals and corporates. The company was formerly known as Indian Leasers Limited and changed its name to Indian Infotech and Software Limited in July 1998. Indian Infotech and Software Limited was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Mumbai, India.
